evidence_basis: Existing development cases plus already-observed adversarial-v5 failure diagnostics only. No new confirmatory cases were observed before selection.

hypotheses.name: Evidence entailment
hypotheses.new_information_introduced: Proposition-support verdict rather than similarity score.
hypotheses.reason: Necessary but a monolithic entailment proxy can miss temporal and multi-evidence conflicts.

hypotheses.name: Query decomposition and slot coverage
hypotheses.new_information_introduced: Explicit subject, requested attribute/relation, temporal scope, certainty and value slots.
hypotheses.reason: Strongest single mechanism for wrong-field and temporal failures, but does not alone resolve conflicts.

hypotheses.name: Evidence consistency graph
hypotheses.new_information_introduced: Cross-memory agreement, contradiction, uncertainty and update-resolution state.
hypotheses.reason: Targets unresolved conflict but is insufficient for single misleading memories.

hypotheses.expected_false_abstention_risk: LOW if not used as a multi-source requirement
hypotheses.name: Counterfactual answerability test
hypotheses.new_information_introduced: Tests whether apparent support disappears when lexical-copy/boilerplate evidence is excluded.
hypotheses.reason: Useful veto, but cannot require multiple independent memories because legitimate single-support cases exist.

hypotheses.name: Lightweight learned answerability classifier
hypotheses.reason: Small development corpus and already-observed v5 diagnostics create unnecessary overfit/leakage risk; deterministic mechanisms are adequate to test the research question first.

selected_architecture.decision: SUPPORTED => return the frozen Candidate-v2 ranking unchanged; CONTRADICTED or INSUFFICIENT => abstain with an empty ranking.
selected_architecture.name: Frozen-v2 retrieval + deterministic proposition/slot answerability gate
selected_architecture.reason: This separates ranking from answerability, directly addresses every observed no-evidence failure family, and minimizes false-abstention/retrieval-regression risk by never reordering a supported v2 result.
